exports.n: Customs data record 34.5 Mt of wheat exports from Russia in 2024 (CEPII BACI); USDA PSD gives 55.5 Mt for 2023/24 and 43 Mt for 2024/25. These flows may rest on importers' declarations alone, so that destinations which do not report are missing; this is not established here. The customs figure is 38% below the first and 20% below the second. Importers that took wheat from Russia in 2019 to 2021 and have none recorded in 2024: Bangladesh (1.75 Mt a year on average), Iran (1.24 Mt a year on average), Sudan (1 Mt a year on average), Yemen (0.93 Mt a year on average), DR Congo (0.548 Mt a year on average); the flows and lanes to them are zero in 2024. The flows and lanes are the customs records as they are: no tonnage is added to bring them to the USDA figure.
